title: Forever Add-on Catalog: add-on details
description: addons/<id>.json, written by scripts/details.cs: what an add-on's author wrote (README, release notes, screenshots) and facts about it (stats, languages, technical details), fetched by the app only when the add-on is opened. Markdown fields hold no raw HTML, and their links are absolute. Rules the schema can't express are checked by scripts/validate.cs.

$schema.description: Optional link to this schema, for editors.

schemaVersion.description: Always 1 for this format. The app ignores a detail file whose schemaVersion it doesn't know and shows the catalog's data.

id.description: The add-on's catalog ID; the file is named after it.

repo.description: The GitHub repository it was read from (owner/name).

aboutTruncated.description: True when the README was cut at the size cap; the rest is on GitHub.

releases.description: The most recent stable releases, newest first (at most 5).

name.description: The release's title, when it isn't just the tag.

truncated.description: True when the notes were cut at the size cap.

changelog.description: The repo's CHANGELOG, as Markdown, only when no release has notes.

changelogTruncated.description: True when the changelog was cut at the size cap.

screenshots.description: Images on GitHub, from the README or a screenshots folder, linked, never copied (at most 12).

openIssues.description: Left out when the repo has issues turned off.

contributors.description: Left out when GitHub won't say.

releaseDates.description: The days of the most recent stable releases, newest first (at most 50).

languages.description: The locales the main .toc has a Title-xxXX or Notes-xxXX for.

folders.description: The add-on's folders, as in catalog.json.

editions.description: The editions its .toc files list an Interface for, checked or not.

optional.description: Folders the main .toc uses when present (OptionalDeps).
